summary: LeonaBio filed an 8-K on September 22, 2026, disclosing under Item 8.01 that its Series A Common Warrants, issued in a December 2025 private placement, became exercisable on September 18, 2026. The warrants cover 23,031,494 shares at $6.35 per share and expire October 19, 2026; full cash exercise would raise about $146.2 million. No advisor or board recommendation is named, and no deal terms are set. The event is a near-term cash overhang; watch cashless exercise risk if the resale registration is not effective, and potential dilution versus proceeds.
